text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: …Oh dear. Please forgive me, Trainer. I'm sorry you had to see that.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Truth be told, I happened upon a word puzzle at the back of a magazine last night.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: I just couldn't help myself, and set about solving it. By the time I'd finished, though, the sun was starting to rise.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: But I must say, there's nothing like getting into bed with a real sense of accomplishment! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It looks like Mejiro Bright didn't get enough sleep…
